title: Add the migration runner and schema guard
acceptance:
Story: a newer server copy upgrades the store, and an older copy never corrupts it.
Expected: migrations apply in order, each inside a transaction, the schema version is recorded in the store, and a copy that meets a newer schema refuses to start with a clear message.
Not expected: downgrade support or migration while another process holds the store.
Depends on: the WI-10 store layout.
Verify: a test bumps the stored schema past the copy and expects the boot refusal; acceptance restart shows no re-migration.
evidence: Ordered migrations 1 to 2 with schema_meta; a store newer than the copy refuses to start. Node test refuses a store newer than this copy supports exits 1 with the refusal message; acceptance restart shows no re-migration. PR #6: https://github.com/chakibelbassam/FoundationOS/pull/6.
